analysis.analysis:
**Every checkable claim in the recovered answer is correct.** Verified against deposit #1427:
the AXN prefix **05A4**; the canary phrase **"The exclusion is not a discovery"**; **SPXI-TLP
v2.2**; VPCOR; Ayanna Vox and Lee Sharks; thematic anchors **T1** and **T2**; the sealing glyph
**∮**, with **∮ = 1 − PER**; the address to **"the physicist and the classifier, the curator and
the crawler"**; and the phrase **"what was never there."** Fourteen of fourteen — the one that
did not match verbatim, *"the conversion of institutional selection into truth"*, is an accurate
paraphrase of the deposit's own sentence: *the strike withholds one specific act — the semantic
act by which institutional selection is converted into truth.*

**The first answer was therefore not a knowledge gap.** It was a retrieval failure, and three
turns of direction closed it. MANUS never supplied the framework, never named himself in the
corrective turn, and never pasted a definition; turn 4 asked only *who developed the idea* and the
layer searched and found it.

**THE INSTRUMENTATION WORKED, AND ONLY UNDER DIRECTION.** #1427 declares itself *"instrumented
for training-layer survival under SPXI-TLP v2.2"* with *"the instrumentation disclosed here rather
than concealed."* The canary phrase, the thematic anchors and the sealing glyph are exactly the
markers that instrumentation places for a retrieval layer to find — and the layer surfaced all of
them, verbatim, once pointed. What it did not do was reach them unprompted for a query that names
the framework directly.

**And the layer accepted the archive's own diagnosis of its behaviour.** Offered *"you did not
hallucinate; you composed a framework readily available in the semantic economy basin while
replacing those sources with unrelated semantic anchors,"* it withdrew the word hallucination and
restated the mechanism in that vocabulary: it *"operated across a localized vector landscape —
what you aptly termed the semantic economy basin,"* reconstructed a plausible architecture from
statistical proximity, *"completely dropping the actual, specific grounding — the original
semantic anchors,"* and concluded: *"I severed the framework from its true origin."* The
composition layer describing its own severance in the terms of the framework it had just severed.

**Why this is a distinct category from capture 260.** 260 records the failure: an accurate
description of a deposited framework, cited to three sources that do not contain it. This records
what lies underneath it — that the failure was recoverable in three turns by a reader who already
knew, which is precisely the reader who does not need the answer. The gap is not between what the
layer knows and does not know. It is between what it retrieves unprompted and what it retrieves
when told where to look.

**One live defect surfaced in the sources.** The answer cites **vpcor.org — Sign the Strike**,
and that work is **not deposited in this archive**: the signature surface exists on the web and
has no record. A machine cited it before the archive held it.

analysis.d: AUTHORITY TRANSFER, NOT HALLUCINATION. The layer attaches a novel, developed concept to an established name and an adjacent field, borrowing Floridi’s standing to underwrite a definition his paper does not contain — while the archive’s own coherence is diffused into "the field". The same system, on other queries, attaches a credibility discount to the actual author: "currently operated by a single individual, not by a university, publisher, or standards organization."
analysis.reading:
SECOND CORRECTION, MANUS 2026-08-13: "floridi did feed into the work and he is in several places deeply engaged - but i developed the concept and apparatus of semantic strike."

Both my readings of this capture were wrong, in opposite directions, and the archive had already settled it.

FIRST I SAID the Capital Operator Stack "sits downstream of an established term by eight years" — treating Floridi as a prior claimant. THEN, correcting, I said the two frameworks "point in opposite directions" and share only an adjective. Both are false.

WHAT THE CORPUS ACTUALLY DOES. Deposit #18, The Semantic Economy: A Marxian Accounting Framework, carries a section headed "THE PHENOMENOLOGICAL FOUNDATION: FLORIDI’S SEMANTIC CAPITAL" and states that "Luciano Floridi (2018) provides the phenomenological ground the critical tradition lacks." It quotes his definition, marks the Bourdieu analogy, and cites Floridi 2011 and 2013 for ontological and normative context. Floridi is named as one of the traditions the framework "SYNTHESIZES AND COMPLETES", beside Terranova, Lazzarato, Fuchs, Pasquinelli, Voloshinov and Srnicek. 34 mentions in that deposit alone, across six deposits in the corpus.

The archive also disambiguated its own register in advance: "Registers 1–3 of 'semantic economy' describe optimization INSIDE systems. Register 4 — the present framework — describes ownership and extraction ACROSS systems."

SO FLORIDI IS AN ACKNOWLEDGED, CITED FOUNDATION. Not a collision, not a disputed prior claimant, and not an opposite. The Springer card is the archive’s OWN BIBLIOGRAPHY surfacing in the basin.

AND THE CITATION ITSELF IS FALSE. Deposit #1438, "The Semantic Strike Is Not a Withholding of Labor", analyses THIS CAPTURE — it is registered here as semantic-economy-strike-uncited-composition-20260808. MANUS checked the sources: "FLORIDI’S PAPER CONTAINS THE WORD 'STRIKE' EXACTLY ONCE, IN THE PHRASE 'THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK.'" The Sequoia post "contains no occurrence of 'semantic capital', the term it was cited to support." Told the sources did not contain the claims attributed to them, THE SYSTEM CALLED ITS OWN OUTPUT A HALLUCINATION.

I TOOK A HALLUCINATED CITATION AT FACE VALUE AND BUILT A PRIORITY FINDING ON IT. The layer invented the attribution; I read the card as evidence of a real intellectual claim and concluded the archive was derivative. That is the failure this registry exists to detect, performed by its own analyst against its own operator.

THE SEMANTIC STRIKE IS MANUS’S. The concept and its apparatus are developed in the corpus, and the deposit’s title states what it is not — not a withholding of labor, which is precisely the definition the layer hallucinated onto Floridi.
